facts.fact: The EDPA reports its survey found about 80% of Trade Fair stand visitors not adequately aware of the Data Protection Act and 55.2% of the public finding the Authority difficult to access, and is setting up information desks in major towns covering registration requirements (date is the article's publication date).
The EDPA, with an Acting Chief Executive Officer, is running an outreach campaign with information desks in major towns and says it has a five-year strategy.
